data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for OS media integration across Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, and Web
data.what_it_does: Synchronizes media metadata, playback state, and hardware media buttons with the operating system’s media hub. It provides a lightweight API that can be wired to any audio player via adapters.
use_when: You need lock‑screen or notification controls for background audio
You want a single API for all major platforms
You already have a custom audio player and need OS integration
avoid_when: You only need a simple audio player without OS controls
You are building a web‑only app that doesn’t use media session API
weaknesses: Requires native setup on each platform
data.setup_notes: Add required permissions in iOS Info.plist and AndroidManifest.xml; request notification permission on Android 13+; optional Windows AUMID setup for packaged apps; Linux needs build dependencies (clang, cmake, etc.)
